name: Hellowork
verdict: French job platform whose président is Groupe Télégramme, the independent Breton group now called ADVENN, chaired by Edouard Coudurier. Nothing found.
note: Company register: Hellowork SAS, président GROUPE TELEGRAMME; Advenn's governance page places Hellowork group within Advenn. No state or state fund appears in the sources.
